scope: Independent bounded A3 local regression audit of pinned completed version 3 export

source.version_binding_limitation: Export has no version field. Completed local status, matching IDs, specified run path and export SHA bind this audit to version 3; no global latest or hosted lookup.
source.manifest_note: 13 source snippets discovered; 9 unique pointers executed (dispatch plus verify_identity/get_account/create_promise/close_call hooks). Transfer/callback hooks only hashed, not executed.

method.reuse: A2 audit.py/followup.py copied into owned scratch; exact .a2-copy bytes preserved. Only owned copies retargeted. Original A2 scripts/report never executed or written.
method.execution: Pinned exported dispatch and API pre/post code execute unchanged. Actual schema defaults, response mappings and ordered transitions applied. Config body rendered before pre-hook and hook-mutated body retained. Synthetic receipts only; no HTTP.
method.persisted_variables: Per snippet deep-copy persistent store into vars, then store.update(snapshot). Locally deleted keys remain persisted unless explicitly reset. Extraction is a merge patch; omitted event preserves prior value. Trace records before/after persisted snapshots.
method.fixture: Synthetic single returned product/call facts; state initialized by actual dispatch and synthetic verification/account responses; verified=True never forced.
method.producer: Advertised literal examples and authored latest-reply conforming rows, including required c=0 u=amount/date/both/unknown; independent structural checks and stated semantic basis. No extractor model call.
method.counting: Increment before compile/exec. Outer exceptions count as snippet_aborts; exported catches to safe_failure counted separately. Decoder helper calls/aborts separate. Setup/bootstrap/hooks/receipt dispatches included. Helper aborts include five expected invalid-grammar rejections; they are not exported snippet aborts. Initial 133 plus followup 31 snippets is the complete actual execution count.
method.namespace: Shared globals/locals scaffolding inherited from A2. No strict-split probe performed and no assertion about undocumented platform namespace behavior.
method.limits: No voice/dialogue renderer, global scheduler, ASR/TTS, hosted timing/backend/idempotency/scoring emulation. Export global_nodes is empty.
